name: phluts-quickstart
description: Initialize and validate a Phluts-enabled Flutter project and run first deploy.
default_prompt: Use $phluts-quickstart to initialize my Flutter app with Phluts and deploy a first screen.

name: phluts-screen-builder
description: Build and scaffold Phluts DSL screens and themes from product requirements.
default_prompt: Use $phluts-screen-builder to turn product requirements into Phluts DSL screens and themes.

name: phluts-custom-extensions
description: Scaffold custom Phluts widget/action models and parser integrations.
default_prompt: Use $phluts-custom-extensions to scaffold a custom widget or action parser for my Phluts app.

name: phluts-troubleshooter
description: Diagnose Phluts build, deploy, rendering, caching, and navigation issues.
default_prompt: Use $phluts-troubleshooter to diagnose why my Phluts screen is not building, deploying, or rendering.
